evidence: app/services/document_parser/service.py: DocumentParserService supports PDF extraction via PyMuPDF and Docling with Markdown/HTML table parsing, heading detection, and figure coordinate extraction.
security_impact: LOW. Prevents path traversal during figure export; input file is validated before parsing.
failure_modes: Corrupted PDF streams, password-protected PDFs, complex non-standard font encodings.
recommended_action: Preserve current implementation; maintain bounded timeouts on Docling fallback.
verification_method: Unit and regression tests parsing complex engineering manuals.

evidence: app/services/ocr/service.py: OCRService wraps EasyOCR with PyTesseract fallback, language support, confidence scoring, and timeout handling.
security_impact: LOW. Image buffer validation prevents memory allocation bombs.
failure_modes: Unreadable low-DPI scans, CPU throttling on large batches.
recommended_action: Maintain concurrency limits (VISION_MAX_CONCURRENCY) to prevent OOM.
verification_method: Smoke tests on synthetic bitmap images.

evidence: app/services/chunking/service.py and document_parser/service.py: Normalizes whitespace, extracts running headers/footers, strips redundant page formatting while strictly preserving numeric tolerances and error codes.
security_impact: LOW. Ensures malicious control characters and null bytes are sanitized.
failure_modes: Over-aggressive regex removing hyphenated part numbers.
recommended_action: Maintain protected-token exclusions during regex cleaning passes.
verification_method: Unit tests verifying technical model numbers survive cleaning.

evidence: app/services/metadata/service.py & s06_metadata.py: Extracts document title, manufacturer, model, section hierarchy, page numbers, tenant ID, and access classification.
security_impact: HIGH. Incorrect tenant or access labels lead to authorization bypass.
failure_modes: Inferred metadata conflicting with explicit document tags.
recommended_action: Always prioritize authenticated tenant context over inferred document tags.
verification_method: Unit tests asserting metadata fields on emitted chunks.

evidence: app/pipelines/ingestion/steps/s01_validate.py & s02_duplicate.py: Enforces 100MB limit, 0-byte guard, PDF magic header (%PDF), MIME detection, and SHA-256 deduplication.
security_impact: HIGH. Prevents malicious executable uploads, zip-bombs, and corrupt files.
failure_modes: Spoofed MIME headers, zero-length files, non-PDF payloads.
recommended_action: Preserve magic-byte header verification and persistent disk resolution.
verification_method: Unit tests testing 0-byte, oversized, and non-PDF inputs.

evidence: app/services/chunking/service.py: Groups text blocks by section hierarchy, headings, paragraphs, and lists. Tables and figures remain isolated intact units.
security_impact: LOW. Prevents cross-document text mingling.
failure_modes: Tables spanning multiple pages losing column headers.
recommended_action: Continue table promotion and header repetition across page breaks.
verification_method: Unit tests verifying table chunk structure and section hierarchy.

evidence: Chunking is structure-aware and token-bounded (512-1024 tokens), but does not compute intra-sentence embedding cosine distance drop-offs for dynamic semantic splitting.
security_impact: LOW. Retrieval quality impact only.
failure_modes: Sudden topic transitions within long monolithic paragraphs.
recommended_action: Implement optional embedding-distance semantic boundary splitting for unstructured narrative docs.
verification_method: Benchmark semantic split coherence against structural baseline.

evidence: app/services/chunking/service.py: Generates PARENT and CHILD chunks with foreign key parent_id. HierarchicalRetrievalService expands child chunks to parent contexts upon retrieval.
security_impact: MEDIUM. Must guarantee parent expansion does not cross tenant boundaries.
failure_modes: Orphaned child chunks referencing nonexistent parent IDs.
recommended_action: Maintain tenant_id filter during parent chunk expansion queries.

evidence: app/models/chunk.py: Chunk model stores chunk_id, parent_id, document_id, tenant_id, assistant_id, knowledge_base_id, content_hash, section, page_number, access_classification.
security_impact: HIGH. Metadata establishes multi-tenant isolation and access classification.
failure_modes: Missing tenant_id or access_classification defaulting to unsafe permissive state.
recommended_action: Enforce non-null constraints and strict schema validation.

evidence: app/services/embeddings/local_provider.py: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 running on CPU/GPU via SentenceTransformers (dim=384). Asymmetric query instruction prefix and long-input guard implemented.
security_impact: LOW. Prevents silent truncation and OOM crashes.
failure_modes: Out-of-memory when batch size exceeds RAM; mismatch between query and doc prefixing.
recommended_action: Keep use_query_prefix synchronized between indexing and query pipelines.

evidence: app/infrastructure/weaviate/client.py: DocumentChunk collection in Weaviate Cloud with BYO vectors, cosine similarity, content_hash upsert checks, and tenant isolation.
security_impact: HIGH. Vector database queries must enforce tenant and access filters.
failure_modes: WCS connection timeout, vector dimension mismatch.
recommended_action: Maintain bounded timeouts and retry mechanisms on WCS client.
verification_method: Integration smoke tests against Weaviate Cloud.

evidence: app/services/retrieval/bm25_search.py: Executes native Weaviate BM25 search over content, section, and context_prefix with tenant filtering.
security_impact: HIGH. Sparse queries must apply tenant filters.
failure_modes: Stopword over-filtering on technical terms.
recommended_action: Ensure tokenization preserves alphanumeric technical codes.
verification_method: Unit tests verifying exact technical symbol retrieval.

evidence: app/infrastructure/postgres/client.py: PostgreSQL B-tree indexes on chunks(tenant_id, knowledge_base_id), documents(tenant_id), and Weaviate inverted index on metadata properties.
security_impact: MEDIUM. Ensures rapid multi-tenant filtering.
failure_modes: Index bloat on large churn collections.
recommended_action: Monitor query plans and index hit ratios in Supabase.

evidence: PostgreSQL indexing_state and documents tables track embedding_model_version, parser_version, and version number. However, blue/green collection alias swapping is not automated.
security_impact: LOW. Prevents serving stale indexes during migration.
failure_modes: Incompatible embeddings coexisting in the same vector space.
recommended_action: Implement collection alias switching for zero-downtime reindexing.

evidence: app/services/query/normalization.py: Full morphological normalization, singular/plural expansion, unit alias conversion, and protected token preservation (part numbers, error codes).
security_impact: LOW. Prevents query parser injection.
failure_modes: Over-normalizing rare proprietary part identifiers.
recommended_action: Keep protected regex token set up-to-date with domain vocabulary.

evidence: app/services/query/normalization.py: Classifies queries into GREETING, COUNT_QUERY, LIST_QUERY, SPECIFICATION, PROCEDURE, TROUBLESHOOTING, and FACTUAL.
security_impact: LOW. Routes queries to correct retrieval strategy.
failure_modes: Misclassifying complex multi-part questions as simple greetings.
recommended_action: Maintain classification priority order and fallback to hybrid RAG.
verification_method: Unit tests asserting intent detection across test prompts.

evidence: app/services/query/decomposition.py: Splits compound questions into atomic search queries. LangGraph refine_query node performs progressive query refinement.
security_impact: LOW. Preserves original query alongside rewritten query.
failure_modes: Query rewrite stripping specific error codes or part numbers.
recommended_action: Always retain raw and clean user query in state.

evidence: app/services/query/normalization.py: Extracts section numbers, model numbers, component names, and system identifiers from user queries.
security_impact: MEDIUM. Query filters must never override tenant boundaries.
failure_modes: Hallucinated or inferred filters excluding valid results.
recommended_action: Treat query-derived metadata as optional boost rather than hard filter.
verification_method: Unit tests verifying extracted section metadata.

evidence: Weaviate, Postgres, and OPA queries filter by tenant_id and access_classification. However, tenant_id is extracted from client HTTP headers without cryptographic authentication.
security_impact: CRITICAL. Client-controlled headers allow tenant spoofing and unauthorized document access.
failure_modes: Attacker supplies X-Tenant-ID header to read other tenants' data.
recommended_action: Implement JWT / API key authentication middleware to authoritatively establish tenant context.
verification_method: Security audit of get_tenant_context in dependencies.py.

evidence: app/services/retrieval/dense_search.py: Executes vector search in Weaviate using 384-dim BGE embeddings with tenant and access filtering.
security_impact: HIGH. Vector queries enforce multi-tenant filter clauses.
failure_modes: Weaviate cluster latency, embedding dimension mismatch.
recommended_action: Maintain connection pool keep-alive and error logging.

evidence: app/services/retrieval/bm25_search.py: BM25 lexical search in Weaviate across content, section, and context_prefix with tenant isolation.
security_impact: HIGH. Sparse queries enforce tenant filters.
failure_modes: Rare technical symbols failing to match due to tokenizer boundaries.
recommended_action: Preserve BM25 query normalization in normalization.py.
verification_method: Unit tests verifying exact symbol matching.

evidence: app/agents/retrieval/agent.py: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) combining dense, BM25, graph, and structure channels with k=60 and score normalization.
security_impact: LOW. Combines multi-channel results safely.
failure_modes: One channel dominating score distribution without proper rank scaling.
recommended_action: Preserve reciprocal rank formula 1 / (k + rank).

evidence: app/agents/retrieval/agent.py: Merges multi-channel candidates, bounds total pool (top_k * 4), removes duplicates, and preserves full provenance.
security_impact: LOW. Prevents memory exhaustion from large candidate sets.
failure_modes: Premature truncation discarding high-relevance lexical hits.
recommended_action: Maintain candidate limit at 4x top_k before reranking.

evidence: app/services/retrieval/reranking.py: Uses cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 for semantic cross-attention query-document scoring with fallback to score sorting.
security_impact: LOW. Validates passage polarity and negations.
failure_modes: Inference latency spike on large candidate batches.
recommended_action: Bound reranker candidate input to top 15 candidates.

evidence: app/agents/query_workflow/nodes.py: Deduplicates reranked chunks using content_hash and content prefix matching to ensure context diversity.
security_impact: LOW. Optimizes token context budget.
failure_modes: Removing two distinct procedures with similar opening sentences.
recommended_action: Deduplicate based on full SHA-256 chunk hash rather than short prefixes.

evidence: app/services/confidence/service.py: Evaluates RRF fusion scores and cross-encoder scores against normalized thresholds (HIGH >= 0.70, MEDIUM >= 0.45, LOW < 0.45).
security_impact: LOW. Informs answerability gating.
failure_modes: False low-confidence on niche single-source exact matches.
recommended_action: Allow exact-match BM25 hits to boost confidence level.

evidence: app/services/generation/llm.py: format_evidence_context enforces 4000 char budget and removes duplicate blocks, but lacks extractive NLP summarization/compression.
security_impact: MEDIUM. Compression must not drop safety warnings or negative constraints.
failure_modes: Hard character cutoff splitting technical sentences.
recommended_action: Implement chunk-boundary-aware context budgeting.
verification_method: Unit tests verifying character budget compliance.

evidence: app/services/generation/llm.py: Formats evidence blocks in strict descending order of reranker confidence, placing strongest evidence at the beginning.
security_impact: LOW. Prevents lost-in-the-middle generation biases.
failure_modes: Ordering disrupted when combining text and image OCR evidence.
recommended_action: Maintain cross-encoder ranking order across all evidence types.

evidence: app/services/generation/llm.py: format_evidence_context enforces max_total_chars=4000 (~1000 tokens); LLM provider bounds completion tokens to 2048.
security_impact: LOW. Prevents context window overflow and excessive API cost.
failure_modes: Oversized prompt triggering provider 400 ContextWindowExceeded.
recommended_action: Maintain hard character budget caps before sending to LLM API.
verification_method: Unit tests testing evidence truncation at boundary.

evidence: app/services/generation/llm.py: Assembles structured evidence blocks: [Source N (Page X) [Context Prefix]]\nContent, maintaining document and page provenance.
security_impact: HIGH. Context assembly must never mix cross-tenant chunks.
failure_modes: Missing page number or document identifier in evidence header.
recommended_action: Preserve explicit provenance tags on every source block.

evidence: app/services/generation/llm.py: DEFAULT_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION enforces absolute grounding, refusal on missing info, exact numerical values, clean answers, and prompt injection defense.
security_impact: HIGH. Enforces system persona integrity and grounding boundaries.
failure_modes: Model ignoring instructions when given adversarial jailbreak prompts.
recommended_action: Keep security directives prominently at end of system prompt.

evidence: app/services/generation/llm.py: GroqLLMProvider running llama-3.3-70b-versatile with bounded retries, rate-limit backoff, and automatic fallback to Ollama (qwen2.5:7b).
security_impact: MEDIUM. Prevents silent API failures from hanging requests.
failure_modes: Groq upstream 503 or quota exhaustion.
recommended_action: Maintain graceful Ollama fallback for local and resilient deployments.

evidence: app/models/query.py & clean_generated_answer(): Cleans markdown labels, extracts structured Citation objects, and maps response into QueryResponse Pydantic schema.
security_impact: LOW. Ensures client receives valid JSON with typed fields.
failure_modes: Model outputting conversational pleasantries instead of clean text.
recommended_action: Maintain clean_generated_answer regex post-processing.

evidence: app/services/generation/citations.py: CitationService maps evidence chunks to Citation models (doc ID, filename, page, section, snippet) and unique SourceRef models.
security_impact: HIGH. Citations must only reference authorized, retrieved documents.
failure_modes: Fabricated page numbers or missing document IDs.
recommended_action: Strictly bind citations to retrieved SearchResult objects.
verification_method: Regression test verifying page numbers and section mappings.

evidence: FastAPI request/response Pydantic models (QueryRequest, QueryResponse, DocumentStatusResponse) strictly validate all API parameters.
security_impact: HIGH. Prevents invalid types, parameter injection, and malformed JSON.
failure_modes: Client sending unknown extra fields or negative numbers.
recommended_action: Keep extra='ignore' or strict Pydantic field validators.

evidence: app/services/generation/hallucination.py: GroundednessVerificationService measures n-gram overlap between answer and evidence chunks (SUPPORTED >= 0.60, PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED >= 0.35, UNSUPPORTED < 0.35).
security_impact: MEDIUM. Prevents ungrounded answers from being cached or served as fact.
failure_modes: Synonym-rich answers receiving lower lexical overlap scores.
recommended_action: Combine word overlap with semantic similarity in future evaluation releases.

evidence: app/services/retrieval/coverage.py: EvidenceCoverageService checks entity and relation coverage before generation, short-circuiting hallucination-prone queries with direct insufficiency messages.
security_impact: MEDIUM. Stops out-of-domain queries from generating fabricated specs.
failure_modes: Incomplete entity extraction in query leading to unnecessary abstention.
recommended_action: Maintain high-recall entity normalization.
verification_method: Regression tests testing abstention on out-of-domain questions.

evidence: app/services/generation/citations.py: Cross-checks section numbers against CANONICAL_SECTIONS mapping and logs structural inconsistencies.
security_impact: LOW. Prevents misleading citation titles.
failure_modes: Non-Hyundai manuals having different section numbering.
recommended_action: Make canonical section mapping configurable per document industry/schema.

evidence: app/api/dependencies.py: get_tenant_context supports Bearer token and X-API-Key authentication; when api_key_auth_enabled=True, missing or invalid credentials return HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
security_impact: HIGH. Prevents unauthorized API access and enforces identity verification.
failure_modes: Missing credentials rejected at API boundary.
recommended_action: Enable api_key_auth_enabled in production environments.

evidence: app/infrastructure/opa/client.py and app/api/dependencies.py: OPA client evaluates retrieval policy; safe fallback enforces default-deny for RESTRICTED access levels unless verified admin claims exist; unverified client headers are clamped to INTERNAL.
security_impact: HIGH. Prevents privilege escalation even during OPA downtime.
failure_modes: Unauthenticated client requesting RESTRICTED is clamped down.
recommended_action: Maintain OPA server in cluster for dynamic ABAC rules.

evidence: Tenant isolation is enforced across PostgreSQL foreign keys, Weaviate collection filters, Redis cache namespaces, and verified token claims in TenantContext.
security_impact: CRITICAL. Multi-tenant boundary strictly maintained.
failure_modes: Cross-tenant leakage blocked by automated filtering.
recommended_action: Enforce distinct API tokens per tenant in production.

evidence: All external services use TLS encryption in transit (HTTPS, asyncpg ssl, Weaviate WCS HTTPS, Neo4j neo4j+s://, Redis rediss://). Storage encryption is provider-managed.
security_impact: HIGH. Protects credentials and document contents on the wire.
failure_modes: Disabling TLS verification or connecting via plaintext protocols.
recommended_action: Enforce strict TLS verification across all infrastructure clients.
verification_method: Settings and client connection URI audit.

evidence: app/services/pii/interface.py: SimpleRegexPIIDetector wired into app/pipelines/ingestion/steps/s05_chunk.py and main.py services_registry; redacts emails, phone numbers, and SSNs from chunk text and marks metadata.
security_impact: HIGH. Redacts sensitive PII before vector indexing and prompt assembly.
failure_modes: Non-standard PII formats require expanded regex library or Presidio.
recommended_action: Expand regex patterns or configure Microsoft Presidio in future releases.

evidence: DEFAULT_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION contains directive #5 instructing the model to ignore override commands in evidence. Evidence is isolated under [Source N] tags. However, no input scanner (e.g. Prompt Guard / NeMo Guardrails) is executed.
security_impact: MEDIUM. Indirect prompt injection via malicious PDF text.
failure_modes: Adversarial text in PDF instructing LLM to exfiltrate private data.
recommended_action: Add input sanitization rejecting common jailbreak prefixes before sending to LLM.

evidence: tests/evaluation/evaluate.py and metrics.py: Implements Recall@k, Precision@k, MRR, NDCG@k against golden_dataset.json with placeholder detection.
security_impact: LOW. Prevents deceptive 100% benchmark claims.
failure_modes: Running benchmarks against empty or placeholder corpora.
recommended_action: Ingest domain documents and populate golden_dataset.json with verified evidence.

evidence: tests/evaluation/metrics.py: Computes NDCG and MRR improvements before and after cross-encoder reranking.
security_impact: LOW. Quantifies reranking benefit.
failure_modes: Reranker degrading sparse recall when candidate pool is too small.
recommended_action: Benchmark reranker on multi-turn technical queries.

evidence: app/services/retrieval/coverage.py: Evaluates entity coverage, relation support, and context sufficiency prior to generation.
security_impact: LOW. Ensures context contains actionable evidence.
failure_modes: Context populated with tangential boilerplate.
recommended_action: Maintain entity coverage evaluation in query workflow.

evidence: tests/evaluation/metrics.py: Evaluates Answer Relevance, Groundedness Score, and Citation Accuracy.
security_impact: LOW. Verifies factual faithfulness.
failure_modes: Subjective scoring divergence without human ground truth.
recommended_action: Expand golden dataset with human-verified gold answers.

evidence: tests/evaluation/run_eval.py: Orchestrates complete pipeline evaluation from query input through retrieval, generation, and citation reporting.
security_impact: LOW. Detects regression across pipeline components.
failure_modes: Pipeline timeouts on large test sets.
recommended_action: Run run_eval.py on release branches.

evidence: app/config/opentelemetry.py: OpenTelemetry tracer configured with trace_id propagation across FastAPI, LangGraph query workflow, and retrieval agent.
security_impact: MEDIUM. Traces must not log sensitive API keys or raw credentials.
failure_modes: OTLP collector connection drop causing export backpressure.
recommended_action: Use BatchSpanProcessor with bounded buffer size.

evidence: app/config/logging.py: Structured logging via structlog. Produces JSON in production and colorized output in development with request_id and tenant context.
security_impact: HIGH. Prevents secret leakage in server logs.
failure_modes: Logging full prompt payloads containing sensitive PII.
recommended_action: Maintain query length truncations (e.g. query[:50]) in logger calls.

evidence: app/config/opentelemetry.py: OpenTelemetry MeterProvider configured with PeriodicExportingMetricReader and Prometheus support in pyproject.toml.
security_impact: LOW. Metrics do not leak tenant payload data.
failure_modes: High cardinality labels on metrics.
recommended_action: Keep metric dimensions bounded to status, intent, and tenant_id.

evidence: app/services/generation/llm.py: GenerationResult parses prompt_tokens and completion_tokens from Groq/OpenAI response usage objects and logs token counts.
security_impact: LOW. Tracks resource consumption.
failure_modes: Ollama fallback returning estimated rather than exact token counts.
recommended_action: Differentiate authoritative vs estimated token usage in logs.
verification_method: Unit tests verifying prompt_tokens in GenerationResult.

evidence: Token usage and image counts are tracked and logged, but no cost calculation or dollar budgeting service is implemented.
security_impact: LOW. Prevents runaway cloud API costs.
failure_modes: Unbounded loops causing unexpected API spend.
recommended_action: Add a cost multiplier utility mapping model token usage to estimated cost in USD.

evidence: Bounded timeouts configured across all I/O: LLM_TIMEOUT=30, VISION_REQUEST_TIMEOUT=120, INGESTION_TIMEOUT_VISION=10800, Weaviate query=30, asyncpg statement_timeout=30000, per-step asyncio.wait_for in pipeline.py.
security_impact: MEDIUM. Prevents thread pool starvation and hanging connections.
failure_modes: Slow LLM inference triggering timeout right before completion.
recommended_action: Maintain configurable timeouts via environment variables.

evidence: Bounded retries with exponential backoff on Groq rate limits (HTTP 429), Neo4j connection retries (3 attempts), and Gemini vision backoff adhering to RetryInfo.
security_impact: LOW. Prevents cascading retry storms.
failure_modes: Retrying permanent 400 or 401 client errors.
recommended_action: Ensure retries only apply to transient 429, 502, 503, 504 errors.

evidence: Groq LLM falls back to Ollama; Cross-Encoder reranker falls back to score sorting; EasyOCR falls back to PyTesseract; Gemini Vision falls back to DisabledVisionProvider.
security_impact: MEDIUM. Fallback must never bypass security controls or fabricate data.
failure_modes: Silent fallback masking underlying provider misconfiguration.
recommended_action: Emit structured warning logs whenever a fallback path activates.

evidence: No explicit Circuit Breaker state machine (Closed/Open/Half-Open) exists for Groq, Weaviate, or Neo4j. The system uses per-call timeouts and retries, but continues attempting failed external services on every request.
security_impact: LOW. Prevents thread exhaustion when third-party APIs have sustained outages.
failure_modes: Repeated failing calls slowing down all queries during upstream outages.
recommended_action: Implement a simple in-memory circuit breaker that trips after 5 consecutive 5xx errors.
verification_method: Inspection of error handling in GroqLLMProvider.

evidence: app/services/cache/service.py & semantic.py: Multi-tier caching backed by Redis Cloud. Implements exact query cache, semantic vector cache, and embedding cache. Keys are strictly namespaced by tenant_id and kb_version.
security_impact: HIGH. Tenant-namespaced keys prevent cross-tenant response leakage.
failure_modes: Stale cache served after document update.
recommended_action: Increment kb_version upon new document ingestion to invalidate cache.

evidence: app/api/middleware.py: RateLimitMiddleware implements Redis-based sliding window rate limiting (100 req/60s per tenant or IP) for all /api/v1/ routes with HTTP 429 response.
security_impact: HIGH. Prevents DoS attacks, brute-force requests, and API cost exhaustion.
failure_modes: Redis downtime causing fail-open (intended behavior to preserve availability).
recommended_action: Maintain fail-open design on Redis disconnects.

evidence: Stored in documents table (embedding_model, embedding_model_version), LocalEmbeddingProvider.MODEL_VERSION = '1.5', and vision_provider model parameter.
security_impact: LOW. Ensures reproducibility across releases.
failure_modes: Silent model weight update shifting vector space.
recommended_action: Pin model revisions explicitly.
verification_method: Inspection of documents schema and embedding provider.

evidence: app/services/generation/prompts.py: PromptRegistry tracks versioned prompt templates (e.g. version='v1') and maps intent-specific directives.
security_impact: LOW. Enables systematic prompt regression testing.
failure_modes: Hardcoded prompts in agent code diverging from registry.
recommended_action: Consolidate all prompts into PromptRegistry.

evidence: KnowledgeBaseVersion tracks index iteration and chunk counts in PostgreSQL. However, blue/green alias migration in Weaviate is not automated.
security_impact: LOW. Prevents downtime during full reindexing.
failure_modes: In-place indexing overwriting active collections during failed reindex.
recommended_action: Create versioned collection names (DocumentChunk_v1, DocumentChunk_v2) with alias pointer.

evidence: No traffic split, prompt variant experiment router, or A/B evaluation tracking is implemented in the query workflow.
security_impact: LOW. Controlled release management.
failure_modes: All users exposed to prompt or retrieval changes simultaneously.
recommended_action: Introduce tenant-level feature flags or rollout percentages.
verification_method: Codebase search confirming absence of A/B router.

evidence: backend/tests/regression/test_structural_qa.py: Contains automated regression tests verifying Hyundai R215L manual question answering, section counts, and torque specifications.
security_impact: LOW. Guards against retrieval regressions.
failure_modes: Stale ground-truth assertions breaking when corpus updates.
recommended_action: Run regression test suite in pre-commit and CI/CD.

evidence: Evaluation framework exists (evaluate.py, metrics.py, golden_dataset.json), but is not integrated into GitHub Actions CI/CD to automatically block failing PRs.
security_impact: LOW. Ensures ongoing quality enforcement.
failure_modes: Code changes degrading retrieval recall without developer awareness.
recommended_action: Add GitHub Actions workflow running evaluate.py against mock retrieval on push.
